messages:
maria: quick follow-up from last night's pm — postmortem consensus + next steps. i captured the ownerships below, please react if any of these are wrong or you need more time.

maria: tl;dr — recurring pattern: handshake-timeouts + clients not retrying fast-fail -> partial-response/stream cutoffs. root causes: (1) missing sane client backoff defaults, (2) server-side idle timeouts triggering during slow upstream model reads, (3) metric blind spots for 'stream start but no tokens' windows.

maria: action items (owners / rough ETA):
- kevin -> client SDK default reconnect/backoff + docs (PR + integration tests) — due: 2026-04-08
- simone -> server idle-timeout tuning + gating flag for aggressive slow-models (config + e2e test) — due: 2026-04-05
- raj -> observability: k/v cache + 'stream-start-no-tokens' alert, CTA dashboard and runbook snippet — due: 2026-04-03
- dana -> run a 48h canary with adjusted timeouts and capture traces, include sampling of long-tail requests — due: 2026-04-06

maria: kevin, please include a short compatibility note for older SDKs that don't support reconnect hooks.

kevin: ack. i'll open a PR today and prototype the exponential backoff with jitter. will also add a quick snippet in the README for manual retry wiring.

kevin: provisional backoff config i'm planning to add:
```
# client reconnect defaults
backoff_base_ms=200
backoff_multiplier=2
backoff_max_ms=10000
jitter=true
handshake_timeout_ms=6000  # fail faster than server idle timeout
```

simone: for server tuning i'm proposing bumping stream idle from 12s -> 20s and add a per-model slow_read_threshold_ms so we can opt-in for models that stream slowly. i'll add a feature flag rather than global change.

simone: also will add histograms for first-token-latency per model. that should help identify regressions before customer impact.

raj: working on the dashboard concept now — plan: heatmap of sessions by 'start_ts -> first_token_ts' buckets, plus alert when >0.5% sessions exceed 10s gap. will put runbook steps (triage + rollback) in the incident doc.

dana: prepping the canary. question: do we want to run canary only on Dedicated pools or include Hosted as well? i can split traffic.

maria: include both — run on dedicated small percentage first, then mirror to hosted if metrics look good. capture raw pcap/traces for two failcases: client abort and server idle.

kevin: one more ask — should we add an automatic client-side fallback to non-streaming (polling) after N reconnects? might reduce visible partials for ephemeral clients.

simone: i like the idea but we should be cautious — polling changes cost profile. let's do an experiment with a feature flag in the SDK first.

raj: i've found a recurrent weekly spike in the log that matches this pattern — see sample excerpt:
```
2026-03-28T23:14:02Z WARN stream/conn.go:241 handshake timeout after 6100ms client=app-id-xx
2026-03-28T23:14:03Z ERROR stream/serve.go:512 partial response emitted request_id=abc123 tokens=0
2026-03-28T23:14:03Z INFO cache/kv.go:98 hit=false key=prefix:abc123
```

maria: thanks — that log sample helped. raj, please add those patterns to the triage checklist.

incidents-bot: summary created: "streaming-handshake-timeout-pattern". linked doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/streaming-handshake-timeout-pattern (internal).

deploy-bot: heads-up: kevin's SDK PR will require a minor publish; coordinate with release window 2026-04-04 02:00 UTC to avoid the canary.

kevin: noted, i'll schedule the publish outside that window.

maria: final coordination items:
- weekly sync until all items closed (weds 10:00 PT) — owner: maria
- mark each action with a GH issue and add label: incident/streaming-reliability
- raj -> create the alert and a synthetic test (first-token check) by 2026-04-03

simone: i'll pair with kevin on the e2e test matrix (slow upstream, partial frames).

dana: starting canary tomorrow morning; i'll post results in this thread and attach traces.

kevin: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1987 (draft). assigning to @simone for review on server expectations.

maria: thanks everyone — if you hit blockers ping me directly. i'll post an updated action table and owners in the incident doc by EOD. :checkered_flag:

kevin: :thumbsup:

simone: :ok_hand:

raj: assigning time to this in next sprint.

dana: will post canary snapshot here at 2026-04-01T09:30:00Z

maria: closing loop for now, will remind assignees in 48h.
